model_selection.primary_model: Gradient Boosting Machine (e.g., XGBoost or LightGBM) with tuned hyperparameters
alternative_models: Random Forest (for robustness and feature importance)
model_selection.ensemble: Soft voting ensemble of GBM, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression to improve accuracy and generalization
model_selection.rationale: Tabular data with mixed feature types and potential non-linear interactions; ensemble of tree-based models and linear model balances bias-variance, captures feature interactions, and is robust to outliers and missing values.

pipeline_structure.data_loading: Read train.csv and test.csv; combine for preprocessing where appropriate
preprocessing: Handle missing values: impute Age with median/regression, Embarked with mode, Fare with median
Feature engineering: create FamilySize, IsAlone, Title from Name, Cabin deck, Ticket frequency/prefix
Encode categorical variables: one-hot encoding for low-cardinality, label encoding for ordinal if needed
Scale numerical features for linear model; tree models can use raw values
pipeline_structure.model_training: Train each candidate model on preprocessed training data
postprocessing: Apply threshold 0.5 to convert probabilities to binary predictions

training_strategy.validation_split: Stratified 80/20 train-validation split to preserve class distribution
training_strategy.cv_folds: 5-fold stratified cross-validation for hyperparameter tuning and model selection
training_strategy.early_stopping: Use early stopping in GBM based on validation AUC/accuracy to prevent overfitting
training_strategy.hyperparameter_tuning: Grid search or Bayesian optimization for max_depth, learning_rate, n_estimators, subsample, colsample_bytree
training_strategy.final_training: Retrain final ensemble on full training data using best hyperparameters

loss_metric.loss_function: Log loss (binary cross-entropy) for probabilistic outputs
loss_metric.rationale: Accuracy is the final metric, but log loss provides smooth gradient and better calibration; optimizing log loss generally improves accuracy and avoids hard-threshold issues.

correctness: Pipeline runs without errors on provided data
Preprocessing handles all missing values and data types correctly
Model training and prediction produce sensible probability values between 0 and 1
feasibility: Computational complexity is manageable within typical Kaggle notebook limits
All features used exist or are derived from the provided dataset
No leakage: test set not used for fitting scalers or imputers
submission_format_compliance: submission.csv contains exactly two columns: PassengerId and Survived
Number of rows matches the test set size
PassengerId order matches the test.csv order
